description: Authoritative v1 exclusion manifest of WAF request fixtures that are NOT eligible for the Eggbench Security Qualification M002 corpus. Each entry preserves the source fixture ID and a checked-in reason; this manifest is the single product-owned compatibility surface and may not be silently rewritten. Adding/removing exclusions requires a new policy identifier.
